title_en: Professor Emeritus; Chief Consultant, National Mosquito-Borne Diseases Control Research Center
title_zh: 名譽教授；國家蚊媒傳染病防治研究中心首席顧問
expertise_en: Medical entomology; mosquito ecology and vector control; dengue prevention
expertise_zh: 醫學昆蟲學；蚊蟲生態與病媒防治；登革熱防治
summary_en: The team met Prof. Chen before finalizing its topic and interviewed him on 2 July 2024 to present the project idea and get input on its technical direction. He stressed continuous vector-control research and advised on testing the recombinant proteins and sticky ovitrap, suggesting bioassays to prove biolarvicide toxicity. He also referred the team to other mosquito experts, and on 8 August he gave a talk on the application of AI in mosquito control at the team's Dengue Day event, where he praised the project, including Taiwan's first gravitrap.
summary_zh: 團隊在確定題目前即與陳教授會面，並於2024年7月2日訪談他，說明專題構想並請教技術方向。他強調持續投入病媒防治研究的重要性，針對重組蛋白與黏蚊誘卵器的效果測試提供建議，並建議以多種生物檢定證明生物殺幼蟲劑的毒性。他也為團隊引介其他蚊蟲研究專家，並於8月8日在團隊舉辦的「登革熱日」演講「人工智慧在蚊蟲防治上的應用」，肯定本專題的可行性，以及團隊做出的臺灣首個誘殺產卵桶（gravitrap）。
impact_en: His advice shaped the team's research direction and the bioassays used to validate the recombinant biolarvicidal proteins and the sticky ovitrap. His Dengue Day talk added expert content to the team's public education.
impact_zh: 他的建議影響了團隊的研究方向，也決定了用來驗證重組生物殺幼蟲蛋白與黏蚊誘卵器的生物檢定。他在登革熱日的演講則為團隊的公眾教育增添專業內容。

title_en: Professor & Associate Dean, College of Public Health
title_zh: 教授兼公共衛生學院副院長
unit_en: College of Public Health, Institute of Environmental and Occupational Health Sciences
unit_zh: 公共衛生學院 環境與職業健康科學研究所
expertise_en: Medical entomology; vector control; vector-borne diseases; public health
expertise_zh: 醫學昆蟲學；病媒管制；蟲媒傳染病；公共衛生
summary_en: On 2 July 2024 the team presented its research plan, aims and challenges to Prof. Tsai and asked him about the project's technical side. He talked about medical entomology research and the future of synthetic biology in Taiwan, and advised on research design, including comparing experimental and control groups and setting clear variables and constants. According to the iGEM attributions, he also supplied resources for the lab work: team members went to NTU to pick up mosquitoes, and the oviposition assays used an NTU College of Public Health Aedes albopictus lab strain. On 8 August he spoke on eco-friendly approaches to dengue control at Dengue Day.
summary_zh: 2024年7月2日，團隊向蔡教授說明研究計畫、目標與遇到的困難，並請教專題的技術面。他分享了醫學昆蟲學研究與臺灣合成生物學的未來發展，並就研究設計給予建議，包括比較實驗組與對照組、設定明確的變因與常數。依iGEM貢獻表記載，他也提供實驗所需資源：團隊成員到臺大領取蚊子，產卵試驗使用的是臺大公衛學院的白線斑蚊實驗室品系。8月8日，他在登革熱日演講「友善環境的登革熱防治方法」。
impact_en: His advice made the team's experimental design more rigorous (control groups, defined variables), and the mosquitoes his group supplied made the beetroot oviposition and ovitrap functional assays possible. The journal club also discussed his view that AI could be built into ovitraps.
impact_zh: 他的建議讓實驗設計更嚴謹（設置對照組、明確定義變因），他的研究團隊提供的蚊子則讓甜菜根產卵試驗與誘卵器功能試驗得以進行。期刊討論會也探討了他認為可在誘卵器中導入AI的看法。

title_zh: 醫學與法醫昆蟲學研究者
unit_en: Institute of Biological Sciences, Faculty of Science
unit_zh: 理學院 生物科學研究所
expertise_en: Medical and forensic entomology; ovitrap surveillance; insecticide resistance; dengue KAP studies
expertise_zh: 醫學與法醫昆蟲學；誘卵器監測；殺蟲劑抗藥性；登革熱知識、態度與行為研究
summary_en: In an online interview on 5 July 2024, Dr. Chen discussed insect science, insecticide resistance, mosquito bionomics and public awareness of mosquito-borne diseases, and presented a gravitrap starter packet. He noted that catching one female mosquito is like catching about 200 more, because each can lay about 200 eggs. He advised the team to find out how often users should change the water and pellets, to show statistically that their trap works better than traps already on the market, and to write a clear illustrated manual that stresses the trap is non-toxic.
summary_zh: 在2024年7月5日的線上訪談中，陳博士與團隊討論昆蟲學、殺蟲劑抗藥性、蚊蟲生物學與民眾對蚊媒疾病的認知，並簡報了誘殺產卵桶入門資料。他指出，捕到一隻雌蚊就等於少了約200隻蚊子，因為每隻雌蚊可產下約200顆卵。他建議團隊找出使用者應多久更換水與誘餌顆粒、以統計數據證明本產品比市售誘蚊器更有效，並製作附圖的清楚說明書，強調產品無毒。
impact_en: The team kept sticky paper on the inner wall of the ovitrap, added statistical validation and water/pellet replacement tests to its plans, and wrote a detailed instruction manual that emphasizes the trap is non-toxic.
impact_zh: 團隊決定保留誘卵器內壁的黏蚊紙設計，將統計驗證與換水／更換誘餌的測試納入規劃，並撰寫強調產品無毒的詳細使用說明書。

unit_en: Tropical Infectious Diseases Research & Education Centre (TIDREC)
unit_zh: 熱帶傳染病研究與教育中心（TIDREC）
expertise_en: Dengue; vector control; insecticide resistance; tropical medicine
expertise_zh: 登革熱；病媒防治；殺蟲劑抗藥性；熱帶醫學
summary_en: On 18 July 2024 the team asked Assoc. Prof. Low, who sits on the Malaysian Ministry of Health's Technical Working Committee for Insecticide Resistance, about the practicality, research design and execution of its recombinant biolarvicidal protein project. He stressed cost-effectiveness, communication and the biosafety of the proteins. He suggested WHO-standard oviposition assays with different concentrations of beetroot peel powder and recombinant toxins, and the group discussed the biosafety of using recombinant proteins in the field.
summary_zh: 2024年7月18日，團隊請教Low Van Lun副教授——他是馬來西亞衛生部殺蟲劑抗藥性技術工作委員會成員——本專題重組生物殺幼蟲蛋白的可行性、研究設計與執行方式。他強調成本效益、溝通與蛋白質生物安全的重要性，建議以不同濃度的甜菜根皮粉與重組毒素進行WHO標準產卵試驗，雙方也討論了重組蛋白實際用於野外時的生物安全問題。
impact_en: The team learned it had to synthesize the recombinant proteins and test them thoroughly in vitro and in vivo, and it planned oviposition assays across a range of beetroot peel powder concentrations.
impact_zh: 團隊了解到必須先合成重組蛋白，並進行完整的體外與體內測試，也據此規劃了不同甜菜根皮粉濃度的產卵試驗。

title_zh: 教授（重組DNA選殖技術先驅）
unit_en: School of Medicine, Department of Genetics
expertise_en: Recombinant DNA; gene cloning; genetic engineering
expertise_zh: 重組DNA；基因選殖；基因工程
summary_en: On 11 July 2024 the team interviewed Prof. Cohen, who with Herbert Boyer first cloned DNA and moved genes between organisms, about the project concept, especially larvicidal toxins in a chromosome-free system. The team had started experiments in June and could not get the right sequence after transformation. He helped troubleshoot the procedures, shared cloning techniques and experience, and discussed why the project uses a chromosome-free system. The team also asked him how to teach the public about genetic engineering and about safety concerns in cloning.
summary_zh: 2024年7月11日，團隊訪談了與Herbert Boyer共同完成首次DNA選殖、將基因轉移至另一種生物的Cohen教授，請教專題構想，特別是在無染色體系統中表現殺幼蟲毒素的做法。團隊6月開始實驗，轉形後一直無法得到正確序列。他協助排查實驗流程，分享選殖技術與經驗，並討論專題使用無染色體系統的原因。團隊也請教他如何向大眾推廣基因工程知識，以及選殖時的安全考量。
impact_en: His troubleshooting helped the wet lab fix its cloning and transformation problems and firm up the chromosome-free system approach.
impact_zh: 他的排錯建議幫助濕實驗組解決選殖與轉形問題，也讓團隊更確定採用無染色體系統的做法。

photos.caption_en: Online interview with Prof. Stanley N. Cohen
photos.caption_zh: 與Stanley N. Cohen教授線上訪談

org_zh: 緯謙科技股份有限公司
expertise_en: Cloud, data and AI solutions; AI Dengue Fever Prevention Platform (AI mosquito-egg counting and Aedes larva identification)
expertise_zh: 雲端、數據與AI解決方案；AI登革熱防疫平台（AI計數蚊卵與辨識斑蚊幼蟲）
summary_en: On 7 August 2024 the team met WiAdvance, a Wistron subsidiary and Microsoft partner, to discuss a possible collaboration and learn about its AI Dengue Fever Prevention Platform. The 1.5-year project collects images, many taken by the public, and uses AI to count mosquito eggs and identify Aedes larvae, reaching 95% accuracy. WiAdvance suggested looking at Southeast Asia as a market, collecting more pictures to improve the team's photo detector, finding ways to get households to buy the product, and integrating AI.
summary_zh: 2024年8月7日，團隊拜訪緯創子公司、微軟合作夥伴緯謙科技，洽談合作可能並了解其「AI登革熱防疫平台」。該計畫歷時一年半，蒐集大量影像（許多由民眾拍攝），以AI計數蚊卵並辨識是否為斑蚊幼蟲，準確率達95%。緯謙建議團隊把東南亞列為可開發的市場、蒐集更多照片以提升影像辨識準確度、設法吸引家庭用戶購買，並導入AI。
impact_en: The meeting encouraged the team to build AI into its product and to develop its own mosquito egg-counting software.
impact_zh: 這次交流促使團隊將AI導入產品，並自行開發蚊卵計數軟體。

photos.caption_en: Meeting session shown in the WiAdvance section of the wiki
photos.caption_zh: 維基緯謙科技段落所附的會議照片

expertise_en: Synthetic biology entrepreneurship; molecular biology; bio-startup ecosystem
expertise_zh: 合成生物學創業；分子生物學；生技新創生態系
summary_en: On 6 July 2024 the team interviewed John Cumbers, molecular biologist and founder/CEO of SynBioBeta, to learn how to model the business and start a business plan. According to the attributions, he also visited the team's workspace and lab in July and gave a talk on current trends in synthetic biology. He suggested using pest-control companies as a distribution channel, charging them a subscription, offering paid trap maintenance, looking at other markets such as camping, drawing business model canvases for customers and pest-control companies, and collecting data to test assumptions and de-risk the company.
summary_zh: 2024年7月6日，團隊訪談分子生物學家、SynBioBeta創辦人暨執行長John Cumbers，請教如何建立商業模式、著手撰寫商業計畫。依貢獻表記載，他7月也親自參訪團隊的工作空間與實驗室，並演講合成生物學的最新趨勢。他建議以既有的除蟲公司作為通路、向其收取訂閱費、提供付費的誘卵器維護服務、開發露營等其他市場、分別為消費者與除蟲公司繪製商業模式圖，並蒐集數據驗證假設以降低創業風險。
impact_en: The entrepreneurship plan names pest-control companies as partners, includes a subscription and maintenance service model, and was built with a business model canvas.
impact_zh: 創業計畫將除蟲公司列為合作夥伴，加入訂閱與維護服務模式，並以商業模式圖建構。

photos.caption_zh: 團隊工作空間的演講活動（維基John Cumbers段落所附照片）

expertise_en: Insecticide R&D and commercialization; vector control products; marketing
expertise_zh: 殺蟲劑研發與商品化；病媒防治產品；行銷
summary_en: On 4 July 2024 the team talked with Ms. Chan, R&D General Manager at the multinational insecticide maker Fumakilla Malaysia, about ovitrap design, vector control, marketing and a customer-centred view of the product, including field use of the recombinant proteins as larvicides. She said the synbio system and its hardware must be user-friendly to sell. She walked the team through insecticide R&D from bench to market: running proper biolarvicidal assays, registering compounds with local regulators, doing market surveys, and educating consumers.
summary_zh: 2024年7月4日，團隊與跨國殺蟲劑製造商Fumakilla馬來西亞公司研發部總經理Chan女士討論誘卵器設計、病媒防治、行銷，以及以顧客為中心的產品思維，也談到將重組蛋白當作殺幼蟲劑實際使用的潛力。她指出，合成生物系統與硬體必須容易使用才賣得出去。她也說明殺蟲劑從實驗室到上市的研發流程：確實進行生物殺幼蟲試驗、向當地主管機關登記化合物、做市場調查，以及教育消費者。
impact_en: The team wrote a detailed instruction manual for the Beeter Trap and a usage guide for MosBeeter, and discussed marketing the product in dengue-endemic countries in its entrepreneurship plan.
impact_zh: 團隊為Beeter Trap撰寫詳細使用說明書，也為MosBeeter編寫使用指南，並在創業計畫中討論將產品推向登革熱流行國家。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with Ms. Yew-Ling Chan
photos.caption_zh: 與Chan女士線上會議

expertise_en: Biotech services (mass spectrometry, extracellular vesicles, protein assays); bio-entrepreneurship
expertise_zh: 生技研究服務（質譜、胞外囊泡、蛋白質分析）；生技創業
summary_en: On 5 July 2024 the team asked Mr. Kong, CEO of the Malaysian biotech company Cytomics, how to get stakeholders to invest in its product, how to promote biotech products, and about pest control in Taiwan. He said to first identify the problem and the demand for a solution, that the product has to be affordable (lower cost while keeping performance), and that countries where dengue is more common could be the main market.
summary_zh: 2024年7月5日，團隊請教馬來西亞生技公司Cytomics執行長Kong先生，如何說服利害關係人投資產品、如何推廣生技產品，以及臺灣的病媒防治情況。他指出應先釐清問題本身與市場需求，產品必須價格親民（壓低成本並維持效能），也可將登革熱較普遍的國家當作主要市場。
impact_en: The team decided to redesign its ovitrap to cut costs before promoting it, and later created the low-cost Pennytrap.
impact_zh: 團隊決定先重新設計誘卵器以降低成本再對外推廣，之後也發展出低成本的Pennytrap。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with Mr. K. C. Kong
photos.caption_zh: 與Kong先生線上會議

title_zh: 科學家、創業家暨投資人
expertise_zh: 創業投資；健康科技；創業
summary_en: On 17 August 2024 the team met Dr. Wong, a scientist, entrepreneur and investor who has worked on several $1B+ investments and exits, to get feedback on its business model and hardware. She stressed consumer-friendly design (size, looks, instruction manual) and product-market fit before scaling up in developing countries, and suggested making the manual clearer and improving the trap's appearance.
summary_zh: 2024年8月17日，團隊與曾參與多家十億美元級企業投資與出場的科學家、創業家暨投資人Ling Wong博士會面，請教商業模式與硬體設計。她強調產品要對消費者友善（尺寸、外觀、說明書設計），在開發中國家擴大規模前也要先確認產品與市場契合，並建議把說明書寫得更清楚、改善誘卵器外觀。
impact_en: The team revised the user manual and made the product more user-friendly and a better market fit.
impact_zh: 團隊修訂了使用說明書，讓產品更好用，也更貼近市場需求。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with Dr. Ling Wong
photos.caption_zh: 與Ling Wong博士線上會議

title_en: Professor of Pediatrics and of Health Policy; Director, Center for Policy, Outcomes and Prevention
title_zh: 兒科與衛生政策教授；政策、成果與預防中心主任
unit_en: Center for Policy, Outcomes and Prevention (CPOP)
expertise_en: Pandemic preparedness; health policy; healthcare value and delivery innovation
expertise_zh: 大流行防範；衛生政策；醫療價值與照護創新
summary_en: On 2 August 2024 the team asked Prof. Wang how to implement the project globally and why it matters there. He said that to help dengue-affected countries beyond Taiwan, the team must lower the production cost of its synbio and hardware system. He pointed them to Stanford's Design for Extreme Affordability course and asked them to apply its ideas to Dengue Beeters.
summary_zh: 2024年8月2日，團隊請教王智弘教授，如何在全球推動本專題以及其意義。他指出，若要幫助臺灣以外受登革熱影響的國家，必須降低合成生物系統與硬體的生產成本。他向團隊介紹史丹佛的「極致平價設計」（Design for Extreme Affordability）課程，請團隊將其理念應用在Dengue Beeters上。
impact_en: The team developed the Pennytrap, a low-cost gravid trap for underdeveloped and dengue-endemic countries, and reworked Prototype 3 around cost-effectiveness.
impact_zh: 團隊開發出適用於低度開發與登革熱流行國家的低成本誘蚊產卵器Pennytrap，並以成本效益為核心改良第三代原型。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with Prof. Jason Wang
photos.caption_zh: 與王智弘教授線上會議

expertise_en: Integrated vector management (larviciding, source reduction) for malaria and dengue in crisis settings
expertise_zh: 危機地區瘧疾與登革熱的整合性病媒管理（殺幼蟲、孳生源清除）
summary_en: On 2 August 2024 the team asked Mr. Gonçalo, a field entomologist at The MENTOR Initiative (an NGO doing vector control in countries such as Angola, Mozambique, Nigeria, South Sudan and Venezuela), for feedback on the Beeter Trap and whether Dengue Beeters could scale. He described vector control in underdeveloped countries and urged eco-friendly, reusable, long-lasting materials to avoid plastic waste. He also recommended convenient, low-maintenance products and said recombinant larvicides will need more synthetic biology education.
summary_zh: 2024年8月2日，團隊請教The MENTOR Initiative（在安哥拉、莫三比克、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、委內瑞拉等國從事病媒防治的非政府組織）的田野昆蟲學家Gonçalo先生，對Beeter Trap的意見以及Dengue Beeters能否擴大規模。他分享在低度開發國家實地執行病媒防治的經驗，強調材料要環保、可重複使用且耐久，避免產生塑膠垃圾。他也建議產品要方便、少維護，並指出重組殺幼蟲劑的推廣需要更多合成生物學教育。
impact_en: The team decided to use beetroot peels from food waste and recycled plastics for the Pennytrap, focused Prototype 3 on sustainability, and did more synthetic biology education (e.g., Dengue Day).
impact_zh: 團隊決定以食物廢棄物中的甜菜根皮與回收塑膠製作Pennytrap，第三代原型以永續性為重點，並加強合成生物學教育（例如登革熱日）。

photos.caption_en: Online meeting with Mr. Gonçalo Martins Alves
photos.caption_zh: 與Gonçalo Martins Alves先生線上會議

unit_en: Health Emergencies Programme – Emerging Zoonotic Diseases, Arboviruses team
unit_zh: 衛生緊急計畫－新興人畜共通疾病部門 蟲媒病毒團隊
expertise_en: Infectious disease epidemiology; arboviruses (dengue); global health programmes
expertise_zh: 傳染病流行病學；蟲媒病毒（登革熱）；全球衛生計畫
summary_en: On 30 August 2024 the team asked Dr. Rojas Alvarez, a medical doctor and epidemiologist leading WHO's arbovirus team, for feedback on the project and on engaging NGOs to promote it globally. She said the Pennytrap would help underprivileged areas and advised starting in local communities, testing in socioeconomically similar areas, and mapping partners once efficacy and cost-effectiveness were proven. She also suggested filming a Pennytrap construction video, having children bring recyclables to build traps, measuring impact through dengue-related school absences, pitching to WHO's TDR programme, and approaching local NGOs before international ones.
summary_zh: 2024年8月30日，團隊請教身為醫師、流行病學家並負責WHO蟲媒病毒團隊的Rojas Alvarez博士，對專題的意見以及如何與非政府組織合作、在全球推廣。她認為Pennytrap對弱勢地區很有幫助，建議先從在地社區做起、在社經條件相近的地區測試，並在證明效果與成本效益後盤點潛在夥伴。她也建議拍攝Pennytrap製作教學影片、讓孩童帶回收物來製作誘蚊器、以登革熱相關的學生缺課情形評估成效、向WHO的TDR計畫提案，並先與在地NGO合作再尋求國際NGO。
impact_en: The team made a Pennytrap video tutorial, contacted NGOs to test the product, and strengthened its local school and community outreach.
impact_zh: 團隊製作了Pennytrap教學影片、聯繫NGO測試產品，並加強在地學校與社區推廣。

org_en: Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare
org_zh: 衛生福利部疾病管制署
expertise_en: National dengue prevention policy, surveillance and outbreak response
expertise_zh: 全國登革熱防治政策、監測與疫情應變
summary_en: The team met Taiwan CDC to learn about current dengue prevention strategies, challenges and possible collaboration. CDC described seasonal measures (May–November): removing standing water, TOCC history-taking by doctors, NS1 rapid tests, spraying in case areas, and tracking imported cases. It also described its dengue risk map, ovitrap trials with the National Mosquito-Borne Diseases Control Research Center in Tainan and Kaohsiung, international data sharing (Singapore, Japan, APEC), and community outreach. CDC said the trap design fits its strategy.
summary_zh: 團隊拜訪疾病管制署，了解現行登革熱防治策略、面臨的挑戰與可能的合作方向。疾管署說明5月至11月的主要措施：清除積水容器、醫師詢問TOCC病史、NS1快篩、病例區噴藥，以及追蹤境外移入病例。疾管署也介紹登革熱風險地圖、與國家蚊媒傳染病防治研究中心在臺南、高雄試行誘卵器監測、與新加坡、日本及APEC的國際資料交流，以及社區宣導做法，並認為團隊的誘卵器設計符合其防治策略。
impact_en: CDC suggested working with the National Mosquito-Borne Diseases Control Research Center to place traps in hot spots, adding local languages on social media, and evaluating traps in high-risk areas such as Kaohsiung. This led the team to put local schools and communities first.
impact_zh: 疾管署建議與國家蚊媒傳染病防治研究中心合作，在熱區布放誘卵器、在社群媒體加入在地語言，並到高雄等高風險地區評估誘卵器成效。團隊因此決定優先深耕在地學校與社區。

title_en: Professor; PI of the Bacterial Pesticidal Protein Resource Center
title_zh: 教授；細菌殺蟲蛋白資源中心（Pesticidal Proteins網站）主要研究者
expertise_en: Bacillus thuringiensis and bacterial pesticidal proteins; protein nomenclature
expertise_zh: 蘇雲金芽孢桿菌與細菌殺蟲蛋白；殺蟲蛋白命名
summary_en: While designing composite biolarvicidal constructs, the team found the 'Pesticidal Proteins' website and contacted Prof. Crickmore, one of its main investigators. He replied about the prospects and challenges of synthetic biolarvicides and helped troubleshoot the team's technical problems, sharing tips on assembly, ribosome binding site (RBS) and linker sequences, and cloning techniques.
summary_zh: 團隊在設計複合生物殺幼蟲蛋白構築體時發現「Pesticidal Proteins」網站，並聯繫網站主要研究者之一Crickmore教授。他回覆說明合成生物殺幼蟲劑的前景與挑戰，也協助排解團隊遇到的技術問題，分享片段組裝的訣竅、核糖體結合位（RBS）與連接子序列，以及選殖技術。
impact_en: With his advice the team learned how to link two or three fragments, chose the strong RBS BBa_B0030, and designed composites such as p20-Cyt2Ba-Xpp81Aa1.
impact_zh: 在他的建議下，團隊學會如何連接二至三個基因片段，選用強效RBS BBa_B0030，並設計出p20-Cyt2Ba-Xpp81Aa1等複合構築體。

org_en: Taiwan Digital Talking Book Association (DAISY Library)
org_zh: 社團法人台灣數位有聲書推展學會
expertise_en: Accessible digital talking books (DAISY) for visually impaired readers
expertise_zh: 為視障者提供DAISY數位有聲書等無障礙閱讀資源
summary_en: Students at the school for the visually impaired told the team they usually get audiobooks from the DAISY Library and hoped the team's dengue audiobook would be available there. The team contacted the Taiwan Digital Talking Book Association to publish it. According to the iGEM attributions, the association (listed as a sponsor) helped convert the audiobooks into compatible formats and upload them to the DAISY library.
summary_zh: 視障學校的學生告訴團隊，他們平常透過DAISY有聲書圖書館取得有聲書，希望團隊的登革熱有聲書也能放上去。團隊因此聯繫台灣數位有聲書推展學會洽談上架。依iGEM貢獻表記載，該學會（列為贊助單位）協助將有聲書轉成相容格式並上傳到DAISY圖書館。
impact_en: The dengue audiobook became accessible to visually impaired readers nationwide through an established platform.
impact_zh: 登革熱有聲書透過既有平台，讓全國視障讀者都能取得。

summary_en: As part of reaching out to other iGEM teams, GEMS Taiwan sent the English version of its dengue audiobook to team HKSSC and asked them to translate it into Cantonese. The Cantonese version is on the GEMS_Taiwan YouTube channel.
summary_zh: GEMS Taiwan在主動聯繫其他iGEM隊伍時，將登革熱有聲書的英文版寄給HKSSC隊，請他們翻譯成粵語。粵語版已上架至GEMS_Taiwan的YouTube頻道。
impact_en: The audiobook now reaches Cantonese speakers, and the collaboration strengthened ties within the iGEM community.
impact_zh: 有聲書因此能觸及粵語使用者，也加深了與iGEM社群的連結。

summary_en: Listed in the iGEM attributions as an external collaborator, Charissa helped digitize the wiki homepage design and made it more appealing by working student drawings into the layout.
summary_zh: iGEM貢獻表將她列為外部合作者。她協助將維基首頁設計數位化，並把學生的繪畫融入版面，讓首頁更吸睛。
impact_en: She contributed to the visual design of the team wiki homepage.
impact_zh: 她參與了團隊維基首頁的視覺設計。

org_en: Taipei City Xinyi District Fude Elementary School
org_zh: 臺北市信義區福德國民小學
summary_en: The team taught Grade 5 students a synthetic biology and dengue lesson: DNA, genes and cells explained with toy-block analogies for ATCG, dengue videos and Q&A games on symptoms and prevention, and a DIY DNA bracelet activity (Grade 3 students first did a base-pairing worksheet). The adjustable knots used here were too hard for the students to tie, so the team switched to elastic thread for later schools.
summary_zh: 團隊為五年級學生上合成生物學與登革熱課程：以積木比喻ATCG來講解DNA、基因與細胞，搭配登革熱影片與症狀、預防的問答遊戲，並帶學生動手做DNA手環（三年級學生先完成鹼基配對學習單）。 由於這次使用的活結對學生來說太難綁，團隊之後到其他學校改用彈性線。
impact_en: Surveys across the four elementary schools: 95% of students clearly understood dengue symptoms, effects and prevention after the lesson (only 7% knew the details before), and 89% said they understood DNA and biology better. The team adjusted its lesson plan between schools.
impact_zh: 四所國小的課後問卷顯示，95%的學生清楚了解登革熱的症狀、影響與預防（課前僅7%了解細節），89%的學生表示對DNA與生物學更了解。團隊也在各校之間持續調整教案。

summary_en: The team taught Grade 9 students synthetic biology and dengue: a blueberry DNA extraction experiment, CRISPR, BioBricks, PCR, gel electrophoresis and cloning, GM foods and their ethics, dengue and the team's beetroot-geosmin ovitrap with Cyt2Ba, and an introduction to iGEM. The students had already learned some of the material, so the team raised the difficulty for later high school classes.
summary_zh: 團隊為九年級學生講授合成生物學與登革熱：藍莓DNA萃取實驗、CRISPR、BioBrick、PCR、膠體電泳與基因選殖、基改食品及其倫理議題、登革熱與團隊結合甜菜根土臭素與Cyt2Ba的誘卵器，並介紹iGEM。 部分內容學生已經學過，團隊因此提高了之後高中課程的難度。
impact_en: 90% of the junior high and high school students reported a positive impact. Many who were wary of GMOs became curious, and some said they were interested in careers in synthetic biology.
impact_zh: 90%的國高中學生表示課程對自己有正面影響；許多原本對基改抱持疑慮的學生轉而感到好奇，也有學生表示有興趣投入合成生物學相關職涯。

summary_en: The team taught preschoolers about dengue by reading the CDC children's story "Kiki Fights Dengue Fever", playing a dengue vocabulary card game (slap the mosquito card, read the word cards aloud), and having the children color mosquitoes while learning the features of Aedes mosquitoes. The card sets were left with the kindergarten teachers for review in later lessons.
summary_zh: 團隊為幼兒園孩童上登革熱課程：朗讀疾管署童書《奇奇對抗登革熱》、玩登革熱英文單字卡牌遊戲（看到蚊子卡就拍、看到單字卡就唸出來），並讓孩子一邊認識斑蚊特徵一邊替蚊子著色。卡牌留給幼兒園老師，供日後複習使用。
impact_en: The children learned to tell Aedes mosquitoes apart from other mosquitoes, which responds to the survey finding that many people don't know Aedes carries dengue. Teachers kept the card game as a review tool.
impact_zh: 孩子們學會分辨斑蚊與其他蚊子，回應了問卷中許多民眾不知道斑蚊會傳播登革熱的結果；老師也保留卡牌遊戲作為複習工具。

summary_en: The team taught visually impaired students about DNA, genes, plasmids and recombinant DNA technology and introduced its dengue project. Students used touch: a double-helix model, a clay plasmid model with a swappable insert, and the gravitrap prototypes. The team also used its audiobook and braille comic book. A Q&A and feedback session followed, and students suggested making the audiobook available through the DAISY Library.
summary_zh: 團隊為視障學生講解DNA、基因、質體與重組DNA技術，並介紹登革熱專題。學生透過觸覺學習：雙股螺旋模型、可替換片段的黏土質體模型，以及誘殺產卵桶原型。團隊也使用自製的有聲書與點字漫畫。課後的問答與回饋時間中，學生建議將有聲書放上DAISY有聲書圖書館。
impact_en: Student feedback led the team to contact the Taiwan Digital Talking Book Association and put its audiobook on the DAISY Library. The team also plans to work with a braille printing company to produce more braille comic books.
impact_zh: 學生的回饋促使團隊聯繫台灣數位有聲書推展學會，將有聲書上架到DAISY圖書館；團隊也計畫與點字印刷公司合作，印製更多點字漫畫。

org_zh: 居家試用志願者（臺北市）
expertise_en: End users of the sticky ovitrap
expertise_zh: 黏蚊誘卵器的終端使用者
summary_en: Of 342 respondents to the team's general hardware questionnaire, 84 agreed to a one-week home trial of Prototype 2 (without biolarvicidal proteins). The team confirmed 10 volunteers across Taipei, each testing for a week between 3 August and 28 September; with team members' households and consenting relatives, there were 40 participants. Each got the trap, sticky paper and a manual, and was randomly assigned to use water only or water with beetroot peel powder, then answered a follow-up survey.
summary_zh: 在團隊硬體問卷的342份回覆中，有84人同意在家試用第二代原型（不含生物殺幼蟲蛋白）一週。團隊最後確認臺北市各區10位志願者，於8月3日至9月28日間各試用一週；加上團隊成員家中及同意參與的親友，共有40位參與者。每人都拿到誘卵器、黏蚊紙與說明書，並隨機分為只加水組與加甜菜根皮粉組，試用後填寫回饋問卷。
impact_en: Trial users mostly commented on the trap's appearance. Together with the survey results (size, manual clarity, acceptable price under NT$800), this feedback led to the 3D-printed Prototype 3 and a revised manual.
impact_zh: 試用者的意見多集中在誘卵器外觀；這些回饋加上問卷結果（尺寸、說明書是否清楚、可接受價格在800元以下），促成了3D列印的第三代原型與修訂版說明書。
